mechanism_narrative: Transit-station mobility is the tightest lead indicator for discretionary retail footfall in London; with TRANSIT pinned near -13 points and showing no positive inflection, commuter-driven retail demand keeps eroding and RETAIL_REC drifts lower over the following two weeks.
failure_condition: The forward 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC exceeds its trailing 28-day mean while TRANSIT remains below -10 points in every week of the forward window.

mechanism_narrative: Once RESIDENTIAL stays above +5 points for two consecutive weeks, home-confinement behaviour dominates and non-essential retail trips are crowded out, so RETAIL_REC falls within seven days of the threshold being crossed.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL weekly mean stays at or above +5.0 points for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: In every instance where RESIDENTIAL holds at or above +5 for two consecutive weeks, the following 7-day RETAIL_REC mean is flat or higher.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in PARKS and GROCERY_PHARM signals voluntary avoidance of all out-of-home errands rather than category substitution; the two series moving down together suppress RETAIL_REC more than either alone over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS and GROCERY_PHARM both print below -5.0 points in the same week
failure_condition: When PARKS and GROCERY_PHARM are both below -5 in the same week, the forward 28-day RETAIL_REC mean is not lower than the trailing 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Falling WORKPLACES combined with falling TRANSIT removes the commuter footfall that anchors high-street retail; the joint decline predicts a deeper RETAIL_REC drop over four weeks than either series would predict alone.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both decline week-on-week in the same week
failure_condition: Joint weekly declines in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT are followed by a higher forward 28-day RETAIL_REC mean in the majority of observations.

mechanism_narrative: Mid-March lengthening daylight and the start of the spring shopping season lift park visits and discretionary trips, so PARKS recovering above -5 points implies RETAIL_REC gains over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean rises above -5.0 points
failure_condition: Every instance of PARKS rising above -5 points is followed by a forward 28-day RETAIL_REC mean at or below its trailing 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained RESIDENTIAL elevation above +6 points reflects self-directed social distancing that persists independently of formal rules; discretionary retail demand therefore stays suppressed across the full four-week window.
regime_hint: voluntary distancing ahead of formal lockdown
failure_condition: The forward 28-day RETAIL_REC mean exceeds the trailing 28-day mean while RESIDENTIAL holds above +6 points throughout the window.

mechanism_narrative: A single week-on-week drop in RETAIL_REC greater than 5 points marks the onset of an enforced closure cascade; TRANSIT, WORKPLACES and RESIDENTIAL jointly confirm the shift and drive a further decline within one week.
candidate_trigger: RETAIL_REC falls more than 5.0 points week-on-week
failure_condition: A greater-than-5-point weekly RETAIL_REC drop is followed by an equal or higher RETAIL_REC weekly mean within the next 7 days.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM weakness alongside RETAIL_REC weakness shows broad-based trip suppression rather than grocery-led substitution; with no substitution cushion, RETAIL_REC keeps falling over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM stays below -8.0 points for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: The forward 28-day RETAIL_REC mean is higher than the trailing 28-day mean in the majority of instances where GROCERY_PHARM stays below -8 for two consecutive weeks.
